description: A text field that filters a list of options as the user types and holds a set of chosen values, drawn as chips inside the field. The field is one tab stop: the arrow keys move a cursor over the rows and between the chips, and the list stays open across presses on rows. The validation vocabulary is ArenaCombobox's. A cap and a collapsed count keep a long set in bounds.

label.description: The control's accessible name. Required, and guarded at runtime after trimming: a field with no name is announced as an unlabelled edit field.

showLabel.description: Whether the label is drawn above the field. False keeps the name for assistive technology and draws nothing, for a filter row with no room for a label.

placeholder.description: Shown in the empty field while no value is chosen. A hint about what to type, never an option.

options.description: The choices, in the order the list draws them.

value.description: The chosen values, in the order they were chosen. A value that neither the options nor an earlier choice holds is kept and drawn as its own text.

max.description: The most values that can be chosen. Absent, there is no limit. Once it is reached, every row not chosen is unavailable and choosing one is announced as blocked; removing a value stays possible.

maxVisible.description: How many chosen values are drawn as chips before the rest collapse into a count. Absent, every chip is drawn and the field wraps. The collapsed values stay readable in the open list, where they are the chosen rows.

clearable.description: Whether a control that empties the whole selection is drawn while a value is chosen. A declared boolean rather than a reading of whether change is listened to; false by default because a field one press can empty is a choice the consumer makes.

loading.description: Options are being fetched. The list reports itself busy and draws a status line in place of the empty one. Declared, never inferred from the options.

filter.description: Who narrows the options by the typed text: the control itself, or the host, which listens to search and passes the options it found. A declared member rather than a reading of whether search is listened to.

disabled.description: Blocks the control and dims it, chips included.

required.description: At least one value must be chosen for the form to be complete. The field reports itself required to assistive technology.

hint.description: A line of help under the field.

error.description: Controlled error message, and the whole validation surface: every value is an option's or one the consumer supplied, so there is nothing for a validator to parse.

valid.description: Forces the valid state, drawn with a check glyph at the field's end.

icon.description: Phosphor class name drawn at the field's start.

name.description: Submitted with the form. Each chosen value is submitted under it as a hidden input, so a form posts a repeated field; nothing is drawn without a name.

change.description: The chosen set changed, by a row, a chip or the clear control; carries the whole new set, never a difference.

search.description: The text the list is filtered by changed; carries the new text, empty after a pick, Escape or a blur. The hook a remote search listens to.
